title: Morning briefing
prompt: Good morning briefing for Dave. Compile, in this order: 1) any background missions that completed or failed since yesterday morning — read the recent records under data/missions/ in your working directory; 2) system vitals — free disk space, memory pressure, and battery level, via shell; 3) today's weather for my location; 4) two or three notable news headlines. Keep the whole spoken report under 120 words, calm HAL register, lead with the most important item. If a section has nothing to report, skip it silently.

title: Downloads watcher
prompt: A new file arrived in Downloads. Identify it and suggest where it belongs.

title: Systems check
prompt: Check disk space, memory, and recent errors. Report anomalies only.
